astaxanthin.overview: Astaxanthin is a carotenoid antioxidant commonly used to support skin, eye, and exercise-recovery goals.
whatItDoes: Provides antioxidant activity in cell membranes.
Is commonly used for skin and eye support routines.
May be used for exercise-recovery support in some regimens.
watchOuts: Mild stomach discomfort can occur in some people.
Check overlap if combining multiple antioxidant-focused products.
Consult a clinician if you use prescription medications or have chronic conditions.

ashwagandha.overview: Ashwagandha is an adaptogenic herb commonly used for stress and sleep-support routines.
whatItDoes: Is commonly used for stress-management support.
May support sleep quality in some users.
Can be part of broader mood and resilience routines.
watchOuts: Can cause stomach upset or drowsiness in some people.
Use caution in pregnancy unless advised by a clinician.
Consult a clinician if taking thyroid or sedative medications.

turmeric.overview: Turmeric and curcumin are commonly used for joint comfort and general inflammatory-balance support.
whatItDoes: May support joint comfort in some users.
Provides polyphenol antioxidant activity.
Is commonly used in wellness routines for inflammatory-balance support.
watchOuts: Can cause stomach upset at higher doses.
Use caution if taking blood-thinning medications.
Check with a clinician if you have gallbladder or liver conditions.

coq10.overview: CoQ10 is involved in cellular energy production and is commonly used for heart and energy-support routines.
whatItDoes: Supports mitochondrial energy pathways.
Is commonly used for heart-health support routines.
May support exercise tolerance in some users.
watchOuts: Can cause mild stomach upset in some people.
May interact with certain blood-thinning medications.
Discuss use with a clinician if you take chronic medications.

probiotics.overview: Probiotics are live microorganisms commonly used to support digestive and gut-microbiome balance.
whatItDoes: Supports gut-microbiome balance.
May help digestive comfort in some users.
Can be used after travel or antibiotic courses under guidance.
watchOuts: Gas or bloating can occur during early use.
Use caution if you are immunocompromised.
Choose products with clear strain and CFU labeling.

whey protein.overview: Whey protein is a dairy-derived protein source commonly used to support daily protein intake and recovery.
whatItDoes: Helps increase daily protein intake.
Supports muscle recovery routines after training.
Provides essential amino acids including leucine.
watchOuts: May cause bloating or stomach discomfort in sensitive users.
Check for dairy allergens or lactose sensitivity.
Review total protein intake when stacking multiple products.

creatine.overview: Creatine supports high-intensity exercise performance and is commonly used for strength-training routines.
whatItDoes: Supports short-burst exercise performance.
Can help strength and lean-mass training goals.
Is often used in sports nutrition programs.
watchOuts: Can cause temporary water retention in some users.
Stomach upset may occur if dose is too high at once.
Discuss use with a clinician if you have kidney concerns.

melatonin.overview: Melatonin is a hormone-related supplement commonly used to support sleep timing and jet-lag routines.
whatItDoes: Supports sleep-onset timing for some users.
May help with schedule shifts such as jet lag.
Is typically used close to bedtime.
watchOuts: Can cause next-day drowsiness in some people.
Avoid driving-sensitive tasks if you feel sedated.
Discuss use with a clinician if taking sedatives or mood medications.
